# Slidesgo

> Slidesgo is a comprehensive platform offering free Google Slides and PowerPoint templates alongside AI-powered presentation tools for educators, businesses, and creative professionals.

Slidesgo provides an extensive library of customizable presentation templates across multiple industries and use cases, complemented by cutting-edge AI tools for presentation generation, lesson planning, and educational content creation. The platform serves educators, business professionals, and content creators with both traditional templates and intelligent automation features.

## AI-Powered Tools

- [AI Presentation Maker](https://slidesgo.com/ai/presentation-maker): Generate customizable presentation templates from text in seconds using AI
- [PDF to PPT Converter](https://slidesgo.com/ai/pdf-to-ppt-converter): AI-powered converter that transforms PDFs into styled PowerPoint presentations
- [AI Lesson Plan Generator](https://slidesgo.com/ai/lesson-plan-generator): Generate customized lesson plans by grade level and subject for educators
- [AI Quiz Maker](https://slidesgo.com/ai/quiz-maker): Create quizzes from reading material with multiple format options
- [AI Icebreaker Generator](https://slidesgo.com/ai/icebreaker-generator): Generate classroom icebreaker activities for group engagement
- [AI Exit Ticket Generator](https://slidesgo.com/ai/exit-ticket-generator): Create exit tickets for lesson assessment and student evaluation
- [AI Tools Hub](https://slidesgo.com/ai): Central hub for all AI-powered educational and presentation tools

## Template Collections by Industry

- [Business Templates](https://slidesgo.com/business): Professional business templates for Google Slides and PowerPoint presentations
- [Marketing Templates](https://slidesgo.com/marketing): Marketing-focused templates for campaign planning and promotions
- [Technology Templates](https://slidesgo.com/technology): Technology-themed templates for tech industry presentations
- [Law Templates](https://slidesgo.com/law): Professional law templates for legal presentations
- [Finance Templates](https://slidesgo.com/money): Money and finance-themed templates for financial presentations
- [Fashion Templates](https://slidesgo.com/fashion): Creative fashion-themed templates for style and design
- [Architecture Templates](https://slidesgo.com/architecture): Architecture templates for building and design presentations
- [Sport Templates](https://slidesgo.com/sport): Playful sport-themed templates for athletic presentations
